form_fields.name: username
form_fields.label: 用户名
form_fields.description: 用于访问接口的用户名
form_fields.guide_short: 建议使用只读监控账号。PostgreSQL 10 及以上授予 pg_read_all_stats，用于读取库统计和当前会话。打开「Top SQL 采集」前，请在本页填写的数据库中安装 pg_stat_statements，并确认该账号可以读取它。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Use a read-only monitoring account. On PostgreSQL 10 and later, grant pg_read_all_stats so it can read database statistics and current sessions. Before turning on Top SQL Collection, install pg_stat_statements in the database named on this page and confirm the account can read it.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密码
form_fields.guide_short: 填写与用户名对应的登录密码，注意不要带入首尾空格；支持含特殊字符的密码。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the password for the configured username without leading or trailing spaces. Passwords containing special characters are supported.

form_fields.name: host
form_fields.label: 主机
form_fields.description: 与设备进行通信的主机
form_fields.guide_short: 填写 PostgreSQL 服务所在的主机 IP 或域名，例如 10.0.0.10；保存前在采集节点 ping/telnet 验证可达。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the PostgreSQL service IP address or hostname, such as 10.0.0.10, and verify network reachability from the collector node.

form_fields.name: port
form_fields.label: 端口
form_fields.description: 与设备进行通信的端口
form_fields.guide_short: PostgreSQL 服务端口，默认 5432；如使用非默认端口请如实填写。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the actual PostgreSQL service port, commonly 5432. Use the configured value for non-default deployments.

form_fields.name: dbname
form_fields.label: 数据库名
form_fields.description: 用于建立监控连接的数据库名
form_fields.guide_short: 填写监控账号可登录的数据库名，默认 postgres；Telegraf 会通过该连接采集各库统计，并忽略 template0/template1。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter a database the monitoring account can log into, commonly postgres. Telegraf uses this connection to collect per-database stats and ignores template0/template1.
form_fields.description_en: Database name used to establish the monitoring connection

form_fields.name: sslmode
form_fields.label: SSL 模式
form_fields.description: PostgreSQL 连接的 SSL 模式
form_fields.guide_short: 按目标要求选择 disable、prefer 或 require。本模板不支持证书路径，verify-ca / verify-full 暂不可用。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Choose disable, prefer, or require according to the target. Certificate paths are not supported; verify-ca and verify-full are unavailable in this template.
form_fields.description_en: SSL mode for the PostgreSQL connection

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: 默认 60 秒；过低会增加数据库压力，过高会延误告警。
form_fields.guide_short_en: The default is 60 seconds. Short intervals increase database load, while long intervals delay alerts.

form_fields.name: gather_pg_stat_statements
form_fields.label: Top SQL 采集
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。打开后，「Top SQL」页才有语句耗时、执行次数和返回行。目标库须已安装 pg_stat_statements，且监控账号可读取；否则采集失败或持续为空。连接数、事务等常规指标不受影响。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. When on, the Top SQL tab shows statement time, calls, and rows returned. The target database must have pg_stat_statements installed and the monitoring account must be able to read it; otherwise collection fails or stays empty. Connections and transactions are unaffected.
form_fields.description_en: Powers the Top SQL tab when enabled.

form_fields.name: gather_pg_wait_events
form_fields.label: 等待事件采集
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。打开后采样当前正在等待的会话（快照，非累计等待时长）。采集当时无等待会话时页为空。与「Top SQL 采集」相互独立，无需额外扩展。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. When on, samples sessions currently waiting (a snapshot, not cumulative wait time). Empty if no session is waiting at collection time. Separate from Top SQL Collection; no extra extension.
form_fields.description_en: Powers the Waits tab when enabled.

advanced_panel.title: 高级采集选项
advanced_panel.hint: 默认项覆盖基础监控。Top SQL 与等待事件默认关闭，展开后按需打开；详细说明见各开关旁的指引。
advanced_panel.hint_en: Defaults cover basic monitoring. Top SQL and wait events are off by default. Expand to turn them on; see the guide beside each switch.
